dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 17, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Red Sox Rout Rays 10-0, Narváez Hits 3rd Homer**

The Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays 10-0 behind strong pitching from Jake Bennett (6.0 IP, 3 K, 0 ER, 1 BB, 1 H) and a three-hit, three-RBI performance from Carlos Narváez, who hit his third homer of the season. Narváez's 3-for-4 day included a 3-run homer to left field. Griffin Jax took the loss for the Rays.

**Brewers Edge Marlins 2-1**

The Milwaukee Brewers narrowly beat the Miami Marlins 2-1, thanks in part to a 6.0-inning performance from Sandy Alcantara (6.0 IP, 7 K, 1 ER, 4 BB, 3 H). Joey Ortiz hit a solo homer for the Brewers.

**Twins Outlast Cubs 5-2**

The Minnesota Twins edged the Chicago Cubs 5-2, led by Bailey Ober's 5.1 innings of work (5.1 IP, 7 K, 2 ER, 2 BB, 5 H). Ryan Jeffers hit a solo homer for the Twins.

**Orioles Upset Astros 3-2**

The Baltimore Orioles surprised the Houston Astros 3-2, behind Peter Lambert's 6.0 innings of work (6.0 IP, 10 K, 1 ER, 3 BB, 3 H). Taylor Ward hit a solo homer for the Orioles.

**Reds Rout Rockies 7-2**

The Cincinnati Reds cruised to a 7-2 win over the Colorado Rockies, thanks in part to a 7.0-inning performance from Brady Singer (7.0 IP, 6 K, 2 ER, 0 BB, 4 H). Spencer Steer hit two home runs for the Reds.

**Nationals Annihilate Athletics 23-4**

The Washington Nationals crushed the Oakland Athletics 23-4, led by Cade Cavalli's 6.0-inning performance (6.0 IP, 9 K, 2 ER, 0 BB, 4 H). Andrés Chaparro hit two home runs for the Nationals.

**Giants Blank Mariners 7-0**

The San Francisco Giants shut out the Seattle Mariners 7-0, thanks in part to a 5.2-inning performance from Bryce Miller (5.2 IP, 6 K, 2 ER, 1 BB, 7 H). Willy Adames hit a grand slam for the Giants.
